## Biomass standardization figures

Standing biomass figures use remaining biomass from the 2022 full harvest (@fig-standing-biomass-stacked).

```{r}
#| label: fig-standing-biomass-stacked
#| fig-cap: "Standing biomass (remaining biomass in 2022) by functional group and treatment across the climate grid"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

if (!exists("fig_standing_biomass_stacked")) tar_load(fig_standing_biomass_stacked)

fig_standing_biomass_stacked
```

Removed-biomass is the 2015 removal harvest, standardised to site-level full-removal (FGB) means.

```{r}
#| label: fig-removed-biomass-stacked
#| fig-cap: "Removed biomass in 2015 by functional group and treatment across the climate grid"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

if (!exists("fig_removed_biomass_stacked")) tar_load(fig_removed_biomass_stacked)

fig_removed_biomass_stacked
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-prop-removed-biomass-stacked
#| fig-cap: "Proportional removed biomass in 2015 by functional group and treatment across the climate grid"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

if (!exists("fig_prop_removed_biomass_stacked")) tar_load(fig_prop_removed_biomass_stacked)

fig_prop_removed_biomass_stacked
```

Total removed biomass in control plots in 2015.

```{r}
#| label: fig-control-biomass-by-site
#| fig-cap: "Total biomass removed in control plots (FGB) in 2015 by site showing variation in baseline biomass across sites"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

if (!exists("fig_control_biomass_by_site")) tar_load(fig_control_biomass_by_site)

fig_control_biomass_by_site
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-removed-biomass-comparison

fig_removed_biomass_comparison
```
